raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the prompt’s intent by conflating “enabling repeatability” with “performing repetitions.” The question asks what a student should do to be able to repeat an experiment, which points to documenting methods (keeping a record of all procedures, option B) so the experiment can be replicated. Instead, the Planner prematurely selected A (do the experiment many times), which is about improving reliability through multiple trials, not enabling replication. This led to confirmation-biased evidence gathering to justify A rather than evaluating the correct enabling step, B.
